finding: Cached Mean/Error formulas combine selected within-run readings, rather than simply calculating the mean/SD of two run means. They are retained separately; derived run means and their SD are explicit new calculations.

Ten source runs contain fewer than 25 numeric cells in the recorded reading columns (11 to 24). The reason for blank cells is not stated; derived means describe available numeric cells only, not a repaired complete run.

Two literal source identifiers differ by a missing opening parenthesis: 04441PP-VIRak(1)-3E5 and 04441PP-VIRak1)-3E5. Each has one trace. This probable naming typo is preserved, not silently merged; 28 literal codes represent 54 trace files.

The source error formulas omit the first replicate and include the source mean row, e.g. STDEV(B3:B7). Source errors are preserved, not treated as correct repeatability SD. New sample SD is explicitly computed from actual replicate readings.
04441PP-VIRak(1)-0 has four numeric values and one dash, despite the article method stating five measurements. Use actual n=4 for this workbook group.
Workbook identifiers omit the E5 extrusion suffix present in matching raw-trace names. Original IDs are retained; no forced join to tensile conditions.

Source error formulas use the second measurement and mean, e.g. STDEV(D2:E2), not the two original measurements. Preserve source errors separately; use labelled derived SD of both actual readings for descriptive repeatability.

Some labelled specimen slots have no numeric readings. Actual counts are retained separately from the article method of three specimens and nine readings. Gloss geometry and illuminant/observer are not stated in inspected method, so absolute display-color conversion is unsupported.

For 04441PP-VIRak(1)-1E1 the source mean/error formulas select seven of nine visible readings (e.g. AVERAGE(B15:B16,B18:B22)); the exclusion reason is not stated. Source cached summaries and newly derived all-visible-reading summaries are separate.
